pack_name: 错位现场 · 纸页与痕迹
direction: 温暖、克制、近距离的纸张与办公物件拟音，适配报纸档案界面与现场重构；环境安静，提示短促。

items.label: 纸签轻触
items.prompt: One tiny dry fingertip brushing a thick paper index tab. Very short delicate papery tick, intimate and quiet. Single soft UI hover sound.

items.label: 纸张按钮
items.prompt: A single fingertip pressing a thick paper card on a wooden desk. Tiny dry papery tap and a very short soft paper rustle. One gentle tactile UI click.

items.label: 档案翻页
items.prompt: Turning one thick newspaper page once. A dry delicate sweep of stiff paper, then the page settles quietly. Natural paper friction, one complete page turn.

items.label: 展开案件档案
items.prompt: Opening a cardboard case folder once on a wooden desk, a muted cardboard flap followed by two loose paper sheets gently rustling. One short natural action.

items.label: 合上案件档案
items.prompt: Closing a thin cardboard investigation folder once. A soft flat papery flap and a muted desk tap with a brief paper settle. Light and dry.

items.label: 拿起照片
items.prompt: Lifting one old photographic print off a wooden desk. A tiny paper scrape and a crisp delicate photographic paper flex, one short close-up action.

items.label: 归档盖章
items.prompt: A small wooden rubber archive stamp pressed down on a paper file once. Firm muted wooden clack, soft paper contact, short natural dry decay.

items.label: 纸面确认
items.prompt: One short neat pencil check mark written on thick paper, a crisp pencil scratch then a tiny gentle pencil tap. Quiet satisfying tactile confirmation.

items.label: 纸面取消
items.prompt: Sliding a small paper note aside once on a wooden desk. A short soft dry paper scrape that stops cleanly. A subdued tactile cancel gesture.

items.label: 终端按键
items.prompt: One single quiet vintage computer mouse button click. A tiny soft plastic mechanical tick with an immediate short release. Clean restrained retro desktop interface sound.

items.label: 终端打开窗口
items.prompt: A quiet vintage office terminal notification: one low soft electronic blip rising slightly and stopping, a warm rounded sine-like tone. Minimal 1990s computer interface sound, no melody.

items.label: 终端关闭窗口
items.prompt: One very short soft downward electronic blip from a vintage office computer. Rounded warm muted tone, understated window closing feedback, no melody.

items.label: 新委托邮件
items.prompt: Two quiet warm vintage computer notification pips, a low pip then a slightly higher pip, with a short pause between them. Subtle new mail arrival alert, compact and restrained, no melody.

items.label: 购买设备确认
items.prompt: A small office cash register transaction once: one soft mechanical click and a quiet small bell ting with a very short decay. Restrained old-fashioned purchase confirmation.

items.label: 终端操作不可用
items.prompt: One low very short soft electronic error pip from an old computer. A muted rounded dull blip, gentle and unobtrusive, no harsh buzzer and no alarm.

items.label: 提起家具
items.prompt: Gently lifting a small wooden piece of furniture off a wooden floor once. A short soft wooden creak and a light friction scrape as its feet release. Natural restrained room foley.

items.label: 转动家具
items.prompt: A small wooden furniture leg pivoting a quarter turn on a wooden floor once. A short dry restrained wood friction rub and a tiny settling tick. One brief rotation action.

items.label: 木质桌柜落地
items.prompt: Setting a wooden office desk gently onto a wooden floor once. A compact low wooden thunk from its feet and a brief warm wood resonance, no crash and no slam.

items.label: 座椅落地
items.prompt: Setting a swivel office chair down once. Soft rubber caster contact on wood and a tiny restrained metal frame rattle, a short clean natural chair placement.

items.label: 厚重柜体落地
items.prompt: A heavy wooden filing cabinet gently lowered onto a wood floor once. One low solid muted thump with a small wooden drawer rattle. Controlled furniture placement, not an impact crash.

items.label: 金属设备落地
items.prompt: Gently placing a metal office machine on a wooden floor once. A muted low contact thunk and a very short small metal casing rattle. Compact dry practical foley, no ringing crash.

items.label: 桌面小物摆放
items.prompt: Placing a small ceramic coffee cup down gently on a wooden desktop once. One light dry ceramic clink with a soft wooden tap and a tiny quick decay.

items.label: 文件资料摆放
items.prompt: Setting a small stack of paper files onto a wooden desk once. A soft flat papery slap followed by a brief delicate paper rustle. One light controlled action.

items.label: 短距离家具拖移
items.prompt: A wooden desk sliding a short distance across a wooden floor once. A quiet dry wooden friction scrape with a slight creak, even and gentle, then stopping. No human exertion sounds.

items.label: 摆放碰撞提示
items.prompt: One small dull wooden knock against a padded obstacle, short dry low tap. Gentle physical obstruction feedback, not a loud impact, no buzzer.

items.label: 进入物件检视
items.prompt: A single soft leather magnifying glass pouch sliding open, with a tiny metallic hinge tick. A brief delicate investigative tool foley, quiet and dry.

items.label: 发现可见痕迹
items.prompt: One faint delicate high glass ting with a warm quiet airy tail, short and understated, a subtle investigative discovery accent. Natural small glass resonance, no musical phrase and no dramatic sting.

items.label: 收集并记录线索
items.prompt: Writing one quick short pencil note on paper followed by a gentle pencil point tap. Crisp intimate pencil scratch, a compact satisfying evidence-recording action.

items.label: 新物件解锁
items.prompt: A small brass filing drawer latch clicking open once with a tiny soft metal chink and a brief muted drawer slide. Tactile understated new archive item unlocked sound.

items.label: 拍摄复原照片
items.prompt: One vintage film camera shutter release. Crisp restrained mechanical shutter click followed by a very short soft film advance lever click. A single photograph, no repeated shots.

items.label: 案件归档完成
items.prompt: One satisfying case file closing followed by a firm rubber stamp and a tiny soft brass desk bell ting. A short dry office foley sequence for a completed investigation. Restrained and calm, no triumphant music.

items.label: 老式终端启动
items.prompt: A vintage CRT office computer switching on once. A small power switch click, short muted electrical static flicker and low fan spin-up, settling quickly into a very quiet hum. No speech and no startup music.

items.label: 短句键盘输入
items.prompt: Typing a short phrase on a vintage office keyboard. A brief irregular cluster of quiet dry plastic key clicks, then a single gentle enter key tap and silence. No voices.

items.label: 打印旧照片
items.prompt: An old office desktop printer printing one page. A short mechanical motor whirr, dry rollers feeding paper, a little carriage movement, then paper ejects and the mechanism stops. One compact print cycle, no voices.

items.label: 饮水机接水
items.prompt: An office water dispenser dispensing a little water into one cup. A soft button click, quiet water trickle and two small hollow bottle bubbles, then water stops. One brief close-miked pour, no splashing mess.

items.label: 台灯开关
items.prompt: One old desk lamp toggle switch being clicked once. A small tactile plastic and metal switch click, dry and close, with a very short muted spring release.

items.label: 咖啡机短萃取
items.prompt: A small office coffee machine running one short cycle. A restrained low pump buzz, gentle coffee drips into a ceramic cup and a little soft steam hiss, then stopping. No voices, no cafe crowd.

items.label: 档案投影仪启动
items.prompt: A small vintage slide projector turning on once. A quiet mechanical power click followed by a low fan spin and one gentle slide carriage clack. Compact dry office machinery, no voices.

items.label: 工作室安静底噪
items.prompt: Steady quiet interior room tone inside a small vintage detective studio. Soft distant ventilation and a very faint constant city wash behind a closed window. Calm warm enclosed office atmosphere, continuous stable texture. No foreground events, no voices, no footsteps, no music, no birds and no alarms.

items.label: 空办公室室内底噪
items.prompt: Steady still interior room tone in an empty office after everyone has left. Very soft low ventilation and a faint distant exterior traffic wash through closed windows. Slightly tense but realistic silence, stable continuous texture. No foreground events, no voices, no footsteps, no music and no dramatic drones.

items.label: 修复室空调底噪
items.prompt: Steady quiet air conditioning and soft distant ventilation inside an empty art conservation room. Dry clean indoor acoustic atmosphere, even low machine air noise, continuous stable texture. No foreground events, no voices, no footsteps, no music, no beeps and no outdoor traffic.
